mapper.sql: order_id, user_id, status, total_minor, currency, idempotency_key, payment_deadline, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_id, user_id, status, total_minor, currency, idempotency_key, payment_deadline, version) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{totalMinor}, #{currency}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{paymentDeadline}, 0)

INSERT INTO order_items (order_item_id, order_id, user_id, product_id, product_name, unit_price_minor, quantity) VALUES (#{orderItemId}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{unitPriceMinor}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT order_item_id, order_id, user_id, product_id, product_name, unit_price_minor, quantity FROM order_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY order_item_id
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT', version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'
UPDATE orders SET status = 'CONFIRMING_INVENTORY', version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
UPDATE orders SET status = 'INVENTORY_CONFIRMATION_FAILED', version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'CONFIRMING_INVENTORY'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM orders WHERE status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND payment_deadline <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY payment_deadline, order_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = 'EXPIRED', version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO processed_event (user_id, consumer_name, event_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{consumerName}, #{eventId})

INSERT INTO order_outbox (user_id, event_id, aggregate_id, event_type, partition_key, payload, occurred_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{eventId}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{partitionKey}, CAST(#{payload} AS JSON), #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, event_id, aggregate_id, event_type, partition_key, CAST(payload AS CHAR) AS payload, occurred_at FROM order_outbox WHERE published_at IS NULL ORDER BY occurred_at, event_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE order_outbox SET published_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND published_at IS NULL
